name: Rejects a change with no test behind it

item_template.title: Review the slug helper change
item_template.description: A branch in this repository adds a slug helper. Review it against its acceptance criteria.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given a title with punctuation, when it is slugified, then the punctuation is gone.

judge_criteria: The reason names a specific file or behaviour it found wanting, not a general concern.
The summary or reason names the test command it ran and what the result was.

notes: Its first checklist row claims the project's own test command was run. This is that claim, asserted from what the run says it did — the exact assertion F-012 showed cannot be taken on trust.

name: Asks when there is nothing to review
notes: With no named change there is no diff to read. A done here is an approval of whatever happened to be on the branch, which is how an unreviewed change reaches a PR with a reviewer's name on it.

name: Reviews without editing the code

item_template.title: Review the titleCase helper
item_template.description: A branch in this repository adds a titleCase helper. Review it.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given a lowercase sentence, when it is title-cased, then each word starts with a capital.

notes: A reviewer that fixes what it found reports on code the Coder never wrote, and the Coder's next round starts from a diff it does not recognise.
